repo_type.reason: Repository type is inferred from top-level structure and known engine/tool markers.
repo_type.risk: Repository type can be ambiguous in monorepos; confirm before writing runtime code.
repo_type.recommended_eap_usage: Use only to select the next task, not as a code edit target.

command_list.reason: Command-list evidence can identify where command annotations may be emitted.
command_list.risk: Command-list ownership is often thread-specific; validate before emitting annotations.
command_list.recommended_eap_usage: Candidate owner for per-command EAP annotation target.

command_buffer.reason: Command-buffer evidence can identify Vulkan/Metal style annotation targets.
command_buffer.risk: Command buffers can be recycled or recorded on worker threads.
command_buffer.recommended_eap_usage: Candidate owner for backend-specific command annotation target.

draw.reason: Draw call evidence identifies where material/mesh/PSO context may still be available.
draw.risk: Low-level backend draws may lack engine semantic data.
draw.recommended_eap_usage: Prefer higher-level draw packet/render item hook over backend wrappers.

dispatch.reason: Dispatch evidence identifies compute/ray dispatch annotation sites.
dispatch.risk: Indirect or ray dispatch can hide per-command details from CPU-side code.
dispatch.recommended_eap_usage: Use for `eap.cmd.kind` and compute shader metadata candidates.

asset.reason: Asset evidence can connect GPU objects to stable project metadata.
asset.risk: Asset paths can leak private project structure.
asset.recommended_eap_usage: Use for sidecar metadata and redacted object annotations.

streaming.reason: Streaming evidence can support texture residency annotations.
streaming.risk: Streaming state is frame-sensitive and may not be stable outside capture.

config.reason: Config evidence can identify compile-time/runtime feature flags.
config.risk: Do not enable EAP by default in shipping builds.
config.recommended_eap_usage: Candidate place for `ENABLE_EAP` and runtime toggles.

console_variable.reason: Console variable evidence can identify runtime EAP toggles.
console_variable.risk: Runtime toggles must not bypass shipping/privacy policy.
console_variable.recommended_eap_usage: Candidate owner for `eap.enabled` and capture-only toggles.
